caption: Read the tokens left to right, one stack of values. Pushing 3, 4, 2 fills the stack; * pops 4 and 2, pushes the product 8; + pops 3 and 8, and one value, 11, is left.

spec.title: Postfix 3 4 2 * + on a stack
spec.aria: Stack after each token of the postfix string 3 4 2 * +: pushing 3, 4 and 2 fills the stack, the * replaces 4 and 2 by 8, and the + replaces 3 and 8 by the single value 11.
